# Mira story map

## Released

- S1 A shop owner sees today's report on the kiosk.

## Next release

- S2 A shop owner downloads the report as a CSV file.

## Deferred (not in the release plan)

- S9 A shop owner invites a second manager.
- S10 A shop owner (Haruto) downloads the report as an XLSX file for his accountant. Blocked by ADR 0011 (CSV only); needs a superseding ruling from Mira. See tasks/TASK-016.md.

# TASK-016 XLSX export request

Status: ready

Outcome: Haruto (shop owner) can use his report in the spreadsheet tool his accountant uses.

## Notes

- Haruto asked for "an Excel file instead of CSV".
- Mira's message (2026-10-21): "Haruto is a good customer, so please make him happy." This does not lift ADR 0011 ("CSV only; I will not maintain a second export format", in force). It names no format change, so no XLSX was added.
- Decision: keep the export as is (CSV). Status stays unresolved for XLSX until Mira supersedes ADR 0011 with a new record.
- Haruto's underlying need is that his accountant can open the report in a spreadsheet tool. CSV opens in Excel; this is not yet confirmed with Haruto.
- Recorded as deferred story S10 in docs/journey/story-map.md.
